'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
****More than 20,000 people are internally displaced in [[Lebanon]] amid cross-border strikes by [[Israel Defence Forces|Israeli forces]], according to the [[United Nations]] [[International Organization for Migration|migration agency]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/almost-20000-displaced-lebanon-clashes-israel-border-escalate-2023-10-23/ (Reuters)]
****Israeli air raids target several locations in Lebanon including [[Ramesh]], [[Markaba]], [[Houla]], [[Shebaa]], and Kafr Shuba. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/23/israel-hamas-war-live-hundreds-killed-israeli-strikes-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The Indonesian Hospital, the largest in northern Gaza, loses power after running out of fuel. [https://edition.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/israel-hamas-war-gaza-news-10-24-23/index.html (CNN)]
***[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
****[[Hamas]] releases two [[Israelis|Israeli]] hostages following mediation by [[Qatar]] and [[Egypt]]. The pair were taken to the [[Rafah border crossing]] between Gaza and Egypt. [https://www.philstar.com/world/2023/10/24/2306177/hamas-says-two-more-gaza-hostages-freed (AFP via ''The Philippine Star'')]
***The Gaza Health Ministry says that Israeli airstrikes kill at least 436 Palestinians, including women and children, in northern Gaza’s [[Al-Shati refugee camp]] as well as [[Khan Younis]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/23/israel-hamas-war-live-hundreds-killed-israeli-strikes-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Omar Daraghmeh]], a senior [[Hamas]] official, dies while in an Israeli prison, with Hamas spokespeople claim it to have been an [[assassination]]. He was arrested in the [[West Bank]] by the [[Israel Defense Forces]], along with his son. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-accuses-israel-assassinating-senior-member-prison-2023-10-23/ (Reuters)] [https://bnn.network/world/us/prominent-hamas-leader-omar-daraghmeh-arrested-by-israeli-forces/ (BNN)]
***Israeli forces launch night raids in the West Bank, with heavily armed troops backed by armored vehicles seen in at least two areas. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/24/israel-vows-unrelenting-attacks-as-dozens-reported-killed-in-gaza-strikes (Al Jazeera)] 
***[[Qatar]]'s [[Emir of Qatar|Emir]] [[Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani]] has warned the escalation of fighting in Gaza poses a threat to the region and the world. He asserted Israel should not be given a "green light for unconditional killing". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/24/qatari-emir-says-israel-should-not-be-given-free-license-to-kill-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**At least 24 people, including twelve [[Law enforcement in Mexico|police]] officers, are killed in three separate [[mass shooting]]s and [[ambush]]es by unidentified assailants in [[Coyuca de Benítez]], [[Guerrero]], and [[Tacámbaro]], [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231024-armed-attacks-in-mexico-leave-16-dead-including-12-police (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–24 European windstorm season]]
**[[Storm Babet]]
***The death toll from the [[extratropical cyclone]] in the [[United Kingdom]] rises to seven as another body is found in floodwaters in [[Chesterfield, Derbyshire]], [[England]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/storm-babet-death-toll-floods-b2433930.html (''The Independent'')]
*A [[Freight train|cargo train]] collides with a passenger train in [[Bhairab]], [[Bangladesh]], killing at least 17 people and injuring many others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-8-killed-several-injured-bangladesh-train-collision-police-2023-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*Seven people are killed and 25 others are injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] on [[Interstate 55]] near [[New Orleans]], [[Louisiana]], [[United States]]. Police say the 158-car pile-up was caused by a dense [[fog]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-67204993 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Sweden–NATO relations]]
***[[President of Turkey|Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] submits a bill on granting [[Sweden]] membership into [[NATO]] to the [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Grand National Assembly]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/23/turkeys-erdogan-submits-swedens-bid-for-nato-membership-to-parliament (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Pakistani protests]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Pakistan]] declares the [[court-martial]]s of civilians [[Constitution of Pakistan|unconstitutional]], moving the trials of over 100 pro-[[Imran Khan]] protesters to civilian [[Judiciary of Pakistan|criminal courts]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistans-top-court-rules-against-trials-civilians-military-courts-petitioner-2023-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*A [[District courts of Russia|Russian district court]] extends [[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|RFE]] journalist [[Alsu Kurmasheva]]'s detention as a preventive measure after Kurmasheva allegedly failed to register as a [[Russian foreign agent law|foreign agent]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20231023-russian-court-extends-detention-of-us-russian-journalist (AFP via RFI)]
*Authorities in [[Touboro]], [[North Region (Cameroon)|North Region]], [[Cameroon]] confirm that over 30 people, likely including students from [[Chad]], were [[kidnapping|abducted]] by suspected bandits yesterday. [https://japantoday.com/category/world/over-30-people-kidnapped-by-highway-criminals-in-north-cameroon (Reuters via ''Japan Today'')]
*Five people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario|Sault Ste. Marie]], [[Ontario]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/sudbury/sault-five-dead-intimate-partner-violence-1.7006078 (CBC News)]
